4×4 EXPEDITION · TAJIKISTAN

Pamir Highway & the Wakhan

Cross high passes, share tea in mountain villages and follow the Panj River beside the Wakhan Corridor.

14 daysDushanbe → Wakhan → Murghab → Bartang → DushanbeFrom $1510 / person*Ask about this journey ↗

THE JOURNEY

See the Pamirs
up close.

Cross high passes, share tea in mountain villages and follow the Panj River beside the Wakhan Corridor.

THE ROUTE

Day by day

DAY 01Dushanbe & Hissar+

Arrive in Dushanbe, visit Hissar and meet your local team.

DAY 02Into the Pamirs+

Drive via Kulob to Qalai Khumb and follow the Panj River.

DAY 03Khuf Valley+

Continue to Rushan and settle into a village homestay in Khuf.

DAY 04Khorog+

Walk in Khuf, then travel to Khorog and its botanical garden.

DAY 05Wakhan gateway+

Visit Garm Chashma on the way to Ishkashim.

DAY 06Wakhan Corridor+

See Yamchun Fortress, Vrang and the hot springs en route to Langar.

DAY 07High plateau+

Cross Khargush Pass towards Bulunkul.

DAY 08Murghab+

Explore Yashilkul and the high-altitude town of Murghab.

DAY 09Karakul+

Cross Ak-Baital Pass and stay near Karakul Lake.

DAY 10Bartang Valley+

Travel from the plateau toward the remote Bartang settlements.

DAY 11Jizev+

Walk to Jizev village for a night in a homestay.

DAY 12Panj River+

Return through Rushan to Qalai Khumb.

DAY 13Back to Dushanbe+

Drive to the capital through the mountain valleys.

DAY 14Departure+

Transfer onward from Dushanbe.
